incidents-bot: PAGER: GPU OOM observed on cluster-gamma/node-gpu-11 during prefill stage; container restart loop detected. Severity: P1. Pager engaged at 02:14 UTC.
alejandro: I'm on rotation. assigning to @mira (runtime) and @sam (infra) for triage. brief: high-memory prefill jobs causing cudaMalloc OOMs.
mira: looking at runtime logs now. seeing repeated 'cudaErrorMemoryAllocation' immediately after large prefill. KV cache allocation spikes before the crash.
sam: infra confirms node shows multiple container restarts and dmesg has oom killer entries. GPU mem climbs steadily then drops on reset.
mira: logs snippet:
```
[2026-03-17T02:14:58Z] prefill: request_id=abc123 prompt_tokens=47200 kv_alloc=10485760 bytes
[2026-03-17T02:14:59Z] runtime: cudaMalloc failed: out of memory
[2026-03-17T02:15:00Z] container: process exit status=137 restarting...
```
olivia: customer-success: Acme Retail reported elevated 5xxs starting 02:14 UTC; estimated ~3% of traffic on prod-gamma affected. drafting an initial customer update.
alejandro: quick mitigation plan: 1) cap per-request kv allocation, 2) disable prefix caching on heavy routes, 3) route very-large contexts to cold-model fallback, 4) add temporary circuit-breaker to shed >30k token requests.
mira: applying runtime knobs now: setting kv_per_request_limit_bytes=8388608 on cluster-gamma, toggling prefix_cache_enabled=false for route `/v1/generate/large`.
deploy-bot: Config change applied by mira@runtime: runtime-config/gamma/kv_limit=8MB, route-toggle prefix_cache=false. Rolling restart of runtime pods initiated (pods: runtime-gamma-0..2).
sam: scaled hotpool +2 nodes to give breathing room and cordoned node-gpu-11 for deeper inspection: `kubectl cordon node-gpu-11` then `kubectl drain node-gpu-11 --ignore-daemonsets --delete-local-data`.
mira: also pushed a short-lived circuit-breaker: requests with prompt_tokens > 30000 now receive 503 fallback to small-model-cold to avoid OOM. Monitoring immediate effect.
olivia: sent customer note to Acme: "We've applied mitigations (temporary request limits and fallback routing). Some large requests may be served by a fallback model or return a retryable 503. We're monitoring and will update."
priya: I'll take night handoff at 04:00 UTC. leaving handover checklist: verify nvml traces, collect /var/log/runtime and nvml logs for gpu-11, try reproducer with kv stress harness.
mira: initial impact metrics: container restart rate down ~80% in last 6 minutes; GPU OOM events absent since knobs applied. Still watching for regressions.
alejandro: nice work. keep P1 until stable for 30m post mitigation. please annotate incident ticket with exact config deltas and rollback steps.
incidents-bot: Incident ticket created: INC-2026-0317-4477009000. Link: https://redwood.internal/incidents/INC-4477009000
